name: Cluster-P2P-two-Windows-nodes
comments: Two nodes of a Windows cluster, no load balancer: every client group lists both
nodes, so xmq_scn connects client i to server i modulo two and the clients are
spread over the pair. Subscribers are shifted by one node, so a publisher and
its subscriber sit on different nodes and the cluster has to route the message.
A client whose node goes away does not stay on it: with auto_reconnect and more
than one server, each reconnect attempt asks for the next node in the list, so
the client moves to the survivor.
The accounts are the cluster's shared accounts database: user/User-Secret1.
